whatsapp_share.title: WhatsApp Share
whatsapp_share.subtitle: Send invoices to customers on WhatsApp. Clicking a button opens a pre-filled chat — nothing is sent until you press send in WhatsApp.
whatsapp_share.default_country_code_hint: Used when a customer phone number has no country code, e.g. 91 for India, 1 for the US. Numbers that already include + or a country code are left unchanged.
whatsapp_share.payment_link_hint: Inserted wherever the template uses payment_link (wrap in curly braces). Example: https://infario.com/payments/
whatsapp_share.message_template_hint: Placeholders (wrap each in curly braces): customer_name, invoice_number, amount_due, due_date, company_name, payment_link
whatsapp_share.no_valid_phone: No valid phone number for this customer
